lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region; spatial density is highest along the mid-lateral line where blobs form a semi-regular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot alignments, creating anchor nodes of peak luminance at the intersection coordinates.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank; each features a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal aspect to a shadowed gradient on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of small, high-luminance linear abrasions visible on the lower lateral surface between the fifth gill slit and the pectoral fin insertion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae individuals (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral flank and trailing edge of the pectoral fin; distal tip of the pectoral fin displays a localized high-luminance white marker.
